items.title: A.J. Brown: Top target during joint practice
items.body_text: Brown remained the Patriots' No. 1 option in the passing game during Tuesday's joint practice with the Colts, Ethan Hurwitz of SI.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Justin Jefferson: Building rapport with Murray
items.body_text: Jefferson and newly named starting quarterback Kyler Murray have been starting to click at practice, Will Ragatz of Bring Me The Sports reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Darren Waller: Inks deal with Carolina
items.body_text: The Panthers signed Waller (groin) to a one-year contract Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Takes part in Wednesday's walkthrough
items.body_text: Price (lower body) participated in Wednesday's walkthrough, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Shedeur Sanders: Set to start second preseason game
items.body_text: Deshaun Watson will get the start in Saturday's preseason opener against the Bears, while Sanders will draw the start in the team's Aug. 22 contest against the Bills. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
